description: Ground-truth labels for the rerank A/B evaluation. Each label maps a user-style query to the repository files that a good retrieval result must surface. Labels deliberately use file paths (plus an optional symbol) instead of chunk IDs: chunk IDs do not survive re-indexing.
matchRule: A result matches a label when its chunk's file path (normalized to repo-relative, case-insensitive) equals one of `files`. When `symbol` is set, a strict symbol hit additionally requires the chunk content to contain that symbol string. Metrics: Hit@k (any expected file in top k), Recall@k (share of expected files found), MRR (first expected file), nDCG@10 (binary gains), Precision@5 (hits@5 / 5).
